label: レビュー：材料・機構
classification: A review focused on one material or solvent family, its molecular or structural design, transport/reaction mechanism, physicochemical properties, and stability.
instructions: Connect composition and structure to mechanism, physicochemical properties, performance, and durability. Preserve measurement conditions and distinguish review synthesis from isolated literature values.

sections.heading: 🗾このレビューの要点
sections.instruction: Summarize the material-level conclusions in 3–6 points.

sections.heading: 🧱材料群と設計変数
sections.instruction: Classify materials/compositions and identify structural or formulation variables.

sections.heading: ⚙️分離・反応機構
sections.instruction: Explain the relevant transport, sorption, absorption, or facilitated transport mechanisms.

sections.heading: 🔗構造・物性・性能の関係
sections.instruction: Synthesize how design variables affect properties and performance. Keep metrics, units, and test conditions attached to values.

sections.heading: ♻️安定性・再生・安全性
sections.instruction: Summarize durability, degradation, regeneration, toxicity, corrosion, or solvent loss when covered.

sections.heading: 🔍課題と今後の材料設計
sections.instruction: List author-stated research directions and practical material bottlenecks.
